subject: Starting with R. Problem with plot alignment

messages.author: 4f8ce1d16dae3765
messages.subject: Starting with R. Problem with plot alignment
parts:
Dear all,
I have started working in Shiny today and I am really happy with the platform. Attached my first gui that works as a training example for me.

Currently I have two problems and one think I do not know how to implement

1. I would like to give the option to select the working directory (where the data files for my application are located). That would need the typical browse button where the file system dialog appears. That should return me back the selected working directory

2. I am reading some data based on the user's selection. The user pick some values from the radio boxes and if the file exists that plots the two plots you can see at the right side. What could I do when the file is not there? How to print a kind error message on the main screen or even better grey out already existing plots?

3. The biggest problem currently is aligning  correctly the plots as I want to appear on the right side. As you can see my two plots are really spaced away and I just want the one below the other.
I had to use in my ui.R the following height attributes
 mainPanel(

          mainPanel(
        tabsetPanel(
          tabPanel("Plot", fluidRow(
                     column(10,
                           plotOutput("Variog",height=900),
                           plotOutput("ShadowDistPlot",height=900)))),
          tabPanel("Summary", verbatimTextOutput("summary")),
          tabPanel("Table",plotOutput("plot_measurements_with_map"))
        )
    )

because otherwise they show just a very thin line (like height was set to 10 or 50).

my server code looks like (the relevant plotting parts)


output$Variog <- renderPlot({


    FileToRead<-paste("Data_",input$FreqRadio,"_",input$EnvRadio,".Rdata",sep="")
    #print(FileToRead)

   
    mydat<-load(FileToRead)
   
   
   plot(Data$power,main=input$bins)
ents_with_map(data=cbind(Data$x,Data$y,Data$power))
  #plot(test)
 
  })


I would like to thank you for any help
Regards
Alex
